title: Booking eligibility
content: Laboratory bookings are open to enrolled students and faculty only. Bookings must be made at least 24 hours in advance.

title: Booking duration
content: Maximum booking duration is 3 hours per session. Labs cannot be double-booked; the system must check for time conflicts before confirming.

title: Restricted labs
content: Research labs (e.g. Advanced Chemistry Lab, Robotics Lab) require faculty co-signature approval in addition to standard booking. Standard teaching labs do not require this.

title: Cancellation policy
content: Bookings can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the session with no penalty. Late cancellations may affect future booking priority.
